footer.tagline: Ukuhumusha amaphupho ngobuhlakani bokwenziwa (AI) mahhala ezilimini ezingama-60 — yonke inkolo, ilensi yakho.

home.heroLede: Izimpawu zasendulo, ucwaningo lwangempela lwesayikholoji, nobuhlakani bokwenziwa — kuhlanganiswe ndawonye ukuze kufundwe ngokucacile. Chaza iphupho ngamazwi akho uthole incazelo ngokwenkolo oyithembayo.
home.whyLede: I-Dreamscope ihlelela ipupho lakho izimpawu zalo, bese iyifunda ngendlela okhetha ukuyethemba — kanye nesayikholoji, hhayi esikhundleni sayo.
home.feature1Body: Yonke ipupho lihlelelwa izimpawu zalo eziyinhloko futlelulandelwe ngendlela yokutolika yamakhulu eminyaka.
home.feature2Body: Hlaziya futhi ufunde izimpawu ngesiNgisi, ngesi-Arabhu, ngesi-Spanish, ngesiShayina, ngesiJapane, kanye nezinye izilimi ezingu-55.
home.feature3Body: Ucwaningo lwezengqondo nezindlela zokubuka eziphuma ezinkolelweni ezahlukene — ukufunda okukodwa, okubonwa ngeso lakho.
home.feature4Body: Amaphupho akho ahlala kudivayisi yakho ngokuzenzakalela. Ngena ngemvume ukuze uvumelanise amaphupho akho kuwo wonke amadivayisi.
home.sampleDream: "Ngibone inyoka eluhlaza ishiya indlu ngesango lengadi."
home.sampleReading: Izimfundo zikhombisa izinguquko — into ethile empilweni yakho iyakhulula isikhumba sakudala. Isango siphakamisa ukuthi indlela ecacile iyavuleka. Ezinkolweni eziningi, inyoka engeyona eyingozi eshiya ekhaya ivamise ukusho ukuthi ukukhathazeka okuhlale kukhona ekugcineni kuyasuswa.
home.symbolsLede: Ukusuka emanzini kuya emlilweni, hlola izimpawu zamaphupho ezivamile kanye nokuthi ngayinye ivamise ukukhombisaani ezinkambeni ezahlukene.
home.ctaLede: Imisho embalwa yanele. Ukufunda kuthatha imizuzwana futhi kuhlala kudivayisi yakho ngokuzenzakalelayo.

interpret.title: Chaza iphupho lakho
interpret.lede: Bhala ngezwi lakho. Lapho kunemininingwane eminingi, ukufunda kuba ngokucacile — isimo, imizwa, nanoma yini engavamile konke kubalulekile.
interpret.placeholder: Ezgameni eledlule ngaphupha ngihamba ngomnyango owayehluka unomumo njalo...
interpret.savedConfirm: Kugciniwe kujenali yakho. Uyithola noma inini ngaphansi kwe-Saved.
interpret.disclaimer: Ukubonisisa kuphela — akusikho iseluleko sezokwelapha, sezengqondo, noma senkolo. Asibikezeli ikusasa.
interpret.perspNotice: Isiko ngalinye liboniswa ngokwehlukana. Ukufunda kuyokubonisisa futhi kungenzeka — akusikho okubikezelayo noma izinqumo.
interpret.compareDesc: Iphupho elilodwa, elifundwa ngalensu zonke ngesikhathi esisodwa — bona lapho izinkolo zivumelana khona futhi lapho zehluka khona.
interpret.thanks: Siyabonga — imibono yakho ithuthukisa izifundo ezizayo.
interpret.perspectiveDesc: Ukufunda okukodwa okuxuba izintambo ezihlakaniphile zamagugu omhlaba kanye nengqondo ejulile.
interpret.exampleDream: Ebusuku obudlule ngaphupha inyoni yomhlophe ehlala efasiteleni lami, bese iba incwadi engangingifunda. Ngazizwa ngizola kodwa nginesifiso sokwazi.

about.title: Ukufunda okucacile, okusekelwa yisintu
about.p1: I-Dreamscope ikhona ukuze yenze ukuhumusha kwephupho kufinyeleleke ngolimi lwakho kanye nembangela yamasiko yakho. Sikha izinto zethu emithonjeni ehlukahlukene yokuhumusha — ulwazi lwezinkolo nezomoya, izindaba zesintu, kanye nezindlela zokuhlaziya zenzululwazi yanamuhla — ukuze ukwazi ukufunda iphupho lakho ngendlela oyethembayo.
about.p2: Zonke izifundo zenzelwe ukukusiza ucabange — hhayi ukubikezela ikusasa. Izimpawu ezifana namanzi, umlilo, ukundiza, noma inyoka zithwele incazelo emiphakathini eminingi amakhulu eminyaka, futhi izincazelo zethu zilandelela leyo misebenzi ukuze uthole okuvumelana nempilo yakho.
about.p3: Inkonzo ayihlawulelwa, iyimfihlo ngenhloso, futhi itholakala ngezilimi ezingama-60. Umbhalo wephupho lakho uthunyelwa enkonweni yethu yokuhumusha ukuze kwakhiwe isifundo, bese ungagcinwa ngathi; izifundo zakho zihlala kudivayisi yakho ngaphandle kokuthi ungene ngemvume futhi uvumelanise.
about.card1Body: Ama-Muslim, amaKristu, amaJuda, amaHindu, amaBuddha, amaShayina, kanye nezindlela zengqondo — khetha leyo oyethembayo.
about.card2Body: Kusukela ngesi-Arabhu kuya kusiJapane — humusha ngolimi oluphupha ngalo.
about.card3Body: Izifundo zakho zihlala kudivayisi yakho ngokuzenzakalelayo. Ngena ngemvume kuphela ukuze uvumelanise; susa noma yinini.
about.traditionsLede: Khetha ilensi ethembwa inhliziyo yakho — isifundo ngasinye sidalwa ngesikole sokuhumusha esizinikelele.

contact.title: Thinta thina
contact.lede: Imibuzo, ukulungisa, noma amathuba okubambisana? Finyelela ithimba le-Dreamscope nge-imeyili.
contact.disclaimer: I-Dreamscope inikeza ukukhombisa nokuzijabulisa kuphela. Izinhumushi aziyeluleki zokwelashwa, zengqondo, noma zezenkolo. Uma udinga ukwesekwa, sicela uthintane nochwepheshe ofanelekile.

faq.title: Imibuzo evame ukubuzwa
faq.a1: I-Dreamscope ihlanganisa ulwazi lwamaphupho oluvela ezinkcubeni nezinkolelweni eziningi — okuhlanganisa i-Islam, iKristu, iJuda, iHindu, iBuddha, nezaseChina — kanye nengqondo yanamuhla ejulile. Uchaza iphupho lakho ngamagama akho futhi uthola ukufunda okuhlanganisa izimpawu zalo nokuqukethwe kwazo kuzo zonke izinkcubeni.
faq.a2: Yebo. Amaphupho akho agcinwa kuphela kusitoreji somdabu wesiphequluli sakho esithangamini sakho. Akukho lutho oluthunyelwa kumshini wokugcina, futhi ungasusira umlando wakho nganoma isiphi isikhathi.
faq.q3: Singaphi ulimi lapho ngingaphendula khona amaphupho?
faq.a3: I-Dreamscope isekela izilimi ezingama-60 okuhlanganisa isiNgisi, isi-Arabhu, iSpanishi, isiFulentshi, isiJalimani, isiShayina, isiJapane, isiKoriya, isiTheki, isiPhuthukezi, isiRashiya, isiHindi, nezinye eziningi. Ukufunda kulandela ulimi olukhethayo.
faq.a4: Cha. Ukufunda amaphupho kungokucabula nokuzijabulisa. Akukho ngokwelapha, ngokwengqondo, noma ngokwenkolo. Uma unobunzima, sicela ukhulume nochwepheshe ofanelekile.
faq.a5: I-Dreamscope inamakhasi ahlukile ezimpawu eziyikhulu namashumi amane nesithupha ezivamile — inyoka, amanzi, ukundiza, umlilo, ukukhulelwa, imali, nezinye eziningi — ngayinye etholakal ngezilimi eziningi nezinhlobonhlobo zemibuzo.

profile.title: Indawo Yakho
profile.cloudOff: Umbhalo wakho wephupho uthunyelwa encazelweni yethu ukuze sikhiqize ukufunda, bese ungagcinwabi nguthi. Ukufunda kugcinwa kudivayisi yakho ngaphandle kokuthi ungene ngemvume futhi ukhethe ukuvumelanisa. Asikaze sithengise noma siphendle idatha yakho.
profile.dataNote: Indawo iphi lapho idatha yakho igcinwa khona: idivayisi yakho ngokuzenzakalelayo. Uma ungena ngemvume, ijenerali yakho ingavumelanisa ne-akhawunti yakho yangasese; ungayisusa noma yinini.
profile.signInLede: Ngena ngemvume ukuze ugcine ijenerali yakho yephupho kuzo zonke izinto zakho. Umlando wakho wezivakashi uhamba nawe ngokuzenzakalelayo.
profile.checkEmail: Hlola ibhokisi lakho lokungenela — isixhumanisi sokungena silindile.
profile.signInError: Asikwazanga ukungena. Sicela uzame futhi noma usebenzise isixhumanisi se-imeyili.
profile.googleNotEnabled: Ukungena nge-Google akukaxhunyiwe kuleli phrojekthi. Umnikazi wesayithi kudingeka axhume iklayenti le-Google OAuth ku-Supabase.
profile.guestNote: Ayikho iphasiwedi, ayikho into elandelelayo — nje isixhumanisi. Imodi yezivakashi enesitoreji esitholakala endaweni iyaqhubeka ifumaneka ngokugcwele.
profile.migrated: Ishukile {n} amaphupho kuleli thuluzi iye kujenali yakho.
profile.lede: Konke i-Dreamscope ekwaziyo ngohambo lwakho — kugcinwe endaweni yakho, okwakho wedwa.
profile.emptyState: Akwaphupho okwamanje — ukufunda kwakho kokuqala kuzokhanyisa leli khasi.
profile.connected: Ixhumile — manje usungangena ngemvume futhi uvumelanise ijazi lakho.
profile.connectError: Ayikwazanga ukuxhumana. Hlola i-URL kanye nokhiye ongamaziwa.
profile.privacyNote: Amaphupho akho agcinwa kudivayisi yakho — awakathengiswa, awahlelwa.
profile.autoSetupBody: Awunayo iphrojekhi? Qalisa iskripthi sokumisa kube kanye: yenza iphrojekthi ye-Supabase, faka isakhiwo sedatha, bese iphrinta i-URL yakho + ukhiye ongaziwa ukuze unamathisele ngenhla. Ukungena ngemvume ye-Google kudinga iklayenti ye-Google Cloud OAuth (bona iskripthi).

perspDesc.general: Ukufunda okukodwa okuxaka izintambo ezinhloniphekile zemvelo zomhlaba kanye nokujula kwengqondo.
perspDesc.islamic: Isikole somlando sika-Ibn Sirin — ezimpawu, ezomthetho, nezigxile empilweni.
perspDesc.christian: Ukufunda iphupho emlandweni kaJosefa noDaniyeli, nezimpawu zombhalo ongcwele.
perspDesc.jewish: Ubuhlakani bamaphupho beTorah neTalmud — umyalezo olindele ukuhunyushwa ngokuhlakanipha.
perspDesc.hindu: Izimpawu zeVeda, ikarma, nezwe langaphakathi lengqondo.
perspDesc.buddhist: Ukungapheleli nokuqaphela ngokukhulu ukunaka — buka iphupho ngaphambi kokubambelela.
perspDesc.psychology: Ama-archetype ka-Jung nomthunzi — lokho umqondo wakho okucubungulayo.
perspDesc.chinese: Isichazimazwi esivamile sikaZhou Gong — ukulingana kwe-yin, i-yang, kanye nezinto ezinhlanu.

seo.traditionsBody: Uphawu lungasho izinto ezahlukene ezinkoleni ezahlukene. Ezinkolweni zama-Isilamu, amaKristu, amaJuda, amaHindu, amaBuddha, amaShayina, kanye nezengqondo, isithombe esifanayo sifundwa ngelensi yaso. Khetha ilensi oyithembayo ekhasini lokuhumusha.
seo.tryLede: Yabelana ngephupho lakho uthole incazelo ehlonziwe ngu-AI.
seo.reflectNote: Leli khasi lenzelwe ukucabanga nokuzijabulisa kuphela. Alisiqondiso sezokwelapha, sezengqondo, noma senkolo, futhi alibikezeli ikusasa.
